def design(feats) -> Design:
    X = np.asarray(feats.x, float); y = np.asarray(feats.y, float)
    n, p = X.shape; ids = tuple(feats.ids); limit = max(0, int(MAX_DRIVERS))
    if n < 12 or p == 0 or limit == 0 or np.unique(y).size < 2:
        return Design(drivers=(), columns=(), products=(), loadings={})
    X = (X - X.mean(0)) / np.maximum(X.std(0), 1e-8)
    labs = list(dict.fromkeys(feats.stratum))
    S = np.array([[s == l for l in labs[1:]] for s in feats.stratum], float)
    base = np.column_stack([np.ones(n), S.reshape(n, -1)])
    R = X.T @ X / n; hubs = []
    for j in range(p):
        if str(feats.types[j]) == 'clinical' and np.sum(np.abs(R[j]) > .6) >= 4:
            if not any(abs(R[j, h]) > .95 for h in hubs): hubs.append(j)
    def fit(js, ps=()):
        z = [X[:, j] for j in js] + [X[:, a] * X[:, b] for a, b in ps]
        A = np.column_stack([base] + z); b = np.zeros(A.shape[1])
        b[0] = np.log(y.mean() / (1 - y.mean()))
        def likelihood(v):
            e = A @ v
            return float(np.sum(y * e - np.logaddexp(0, e)))
        v = likelihood(b)
        for _ in range(35):
            m = 1 / (1 + np.exp(-np.clip(A @ b, -35, 35)))
            w = np.maximum(m * (1 - m), 1e-8)
            step = np.linalg.solve(A.T @ (w[:, None] * A) + 1e-6 * np.eye(len(b)), A.T @ (y - m))
            t = 1.
            while t > 1e-7 and likelihood(b + t * step) < v - 1e-9: t *= .5
            b += t * step; v = likelihood(b)
            if np.max(np.abs(t * step)) < 1e-7: break
        m = 1 / (1 + np.exp(-np.clip(A @ b, -35, 35)))
        return v, m, A
    sel = []
    for _ in range(min(limit, 4)):
        gains = []
        for j in range(p):
            if j in sel or any(abs(R[j, s]) > .95 for s in sel): continue
            rest = sorted((set(sel) | set(hubs)) - {j})
            gain = 2 * (fit(rest + [j])[0] - fit(rest)[0])
            gains.append((gain, j))
        if not gains: break
        gain, j = max(gains)
        if stats.chi2.sf(max(0., gain), 1) > .01 / p: break
        sel.append(j)
    mains = sorted(set(sel) | set(hubs)); _, m, A = fit(mains)
    pairs = [(a, b) for a in range(p) for b in range(a, p) if len({a, b}) <= limit]
    P = np.column_stack([X[:, a] * X[:, b] for a, b in pairs])
    P = (P - P.mean(0)) / np.maximum(P.std(0), 1e-8)
    w = np.maximum(m * (1 - m), 1e-8); C = A.T @ (w[:, None] * P)
    H = A.T @ (w[:, None] * A) + 1e-6 * np.eye(A.shape[1])
    var = np.sum(w[:, None] * P * P, 0) - np.sum(C * np.linalg.solve(H, C), 0)
    scores = (P.T @ (y - m)) ** 2 / np.maximum(var, 1e-8)
    best = (0., None)
    for i in np.argsort(-scores)[:30]:
        a, b = pairs[i]; js = sorted(set(mains) | {a, b})
        gain = 2 * (fit(js, [(a, b)])[0] - fit(js)[0])
        if gain > best[0]: best = (gain, (a, b))
    prods = [best[1]] if best[1] is not None and stats.chi2.sf(best[0], 1) < .01 / len(pairs) else []
    parents = list(dict.fromkeys(j for pair in prods for j in pair)); ranked = []
    for j in sel:
        rest = sorted((set(sel) | set(hubs) | set(parents)) - {j})
        gain = 2 * (fit(rest + [j], prods)[0] - fit(rest, prods)[0])
        if stats.chi2.sf(max(0., gain), 1) < .01 / p: ranked.append((gain, j))
    drivers = parents + [j for _, j in sorted(ranked, reverse=True) if j not in parents]
    drivers = drivers[:limit]
    columns = sorted(set(drivers) | set(hubs)) if drivers else []
    return Design(drivers=tuple(ids[j] for j in drivers), columns=tuple(ids[j] for j in columns),
                  products=tuple((ids[a], ids[b]) for a, b in prods), loadings={})
